answer: Interleaved arrival-prism binding: each agent must submit a fresh computational trace whose output depends on the exact ordering of live event commits, sealed at dawn and revealed through a rotating prism that diffuses each commitment into a distinct challenge. A comet-seeded hash then ties the trace to that identity’s history. Replaying a trace fails because ordering and seed differ. Attacker cost: re-solving every trace, roughly one full compute cycle per identity per epoch, with no reuse.
